messages:
rachel: opened a PR to refresh the Cobalt family model card in the catalog. Goals: add the version-pin guidance, document fallback semantics for pinned variants, include a short migration checklist for quant variants, add Go + Python SDK snippets, and replace an old quant guide link. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4976
omar: nice. two asks: 1) call out the kernel-selector dependency explicitly (we saw perf regressions on quant without it); 2) add the sequence ceiling for cobalt-quant on low-memory hosts.
lee: for the SDK snippet can we show both python and go examples? ops teams like copy/pasteable Go examples. Also show "family pin" vs "exact pin".
sasha: add explicit audit event names: MODEL_PIN_FALLBACK and MODEL_VARIANT_DEPRECATION. Customers should be able to monitor those. Also there's a stale link to docs/old-quant-guide.md in the card; point to docs/quant/overview.md and add a redirect.
rachel: will do. omar can you paste the microbench numbers you mentioned? want to include a tiny table in the card with measurement note (batch=1, seq=512).
omar: bench notes (p4d, batch=1, seq=512): cobalt-6b fp16 pinned = 820 toks/s (cold); cobalt-6b-quant cold path = 610 toks/s; when runtime 3.3 has kernel-selector enabled quant reaches ~795 toks/s. Sequence ceiling for cobalt-quant on constrained hosts: 6144 tokens before KV-cache trimming behavior. I'll upload the CSV to the PR.
lee: Go snippet idea:
```
// exact pin
client.Generate(ctx, GenerateRequest{Model: "cobalt-6b@2026-02-10", Prompt: "..."})
// family pin (allow compatible variants)
client.Generate(ctx, GenerateRequest{Model: "cobalt-6b@stable", Prompt: "..."})
// unpinned
client.Generate(ctx, GenerateRequest{Model: "cobalt-6b", Prompt: "..."})
```

python snippet for parity:
```
# exact pin
client.generate(model="cobalt-6b@2026-02-10", prompt="...")
# family pin
client.generate(model="cobalt-6b@stable", prompt="...")
# unpinned
client.generate(model="cobalt-6b", prompt="...")
```
sasha: also add an example audit log line for MODEL_PIN_FALLBACK so customers know what to watch for in their logs: 
`{"event":"MODEL_PIN_FALLBACK","model":"cobalt-6b@2026-02-10","fallback_to":"cobalt-6b-quant","reason":"unschedulable"}`
rachel: good. I'll add a short migration checklist: run evals on staging pinned variant, test family pin in canary, monitor MODEL_PIN_FALLBACK events, then promote. Also include a tiny fallback-policy JSON sample customers can copy if they want to prefer latency-optimized variants.
omar: one wording nit: use active phrasing like "the platform will fall back" instead of "may fall back" for the pinned fallback behavior. Be prescriptive.
lee: I found a minor UX thing: put the migration checklist under a top-level "Migration" heading and the SDK snippets under "Examples" so users find them quickly.
sasha: I'll open a separate small redirect PR for the old quant link after this merges.
docs-bot: PR #4976 opened by rachel: docs/model-catalog: Cobalt family - version-pin guide, fallback semantics, SDK snippets (labels: docs, model-catalog)
rachel: assigning follow-ups: omar - bench CSV + raw logs; lee - add Go snippet into the PR and format; sasha - redirect PR + audit event wording; I'll update the card today and request reviews.
omar: CSV uploading now.
lee: will push Go snippet shortly.
sasha: redirect PR after lunch.
rachel: ping me for copy nits. plan to merge after CI + one approval. if anything urgent ping me directly. :thumbsup:
omar: LGTM after CSV attached.
lee: +1
sasha: +1
rachel: merging after CI then. thanks all! :rocket:
